violations.policy_requirement: Other reservations can be modified without changing the origin, destination, and trip type.
violations.description: Other reservations can be modified without changing the origin, destination, and trip type.
violations.reason: The agent modified reservation 4FDFNE from flight HAT237 (DTW to MSP) to flight HAT035 (DTW to PHX), changing the destination from MSP to PHX. Step 7 shows the original reservation destination was MSP, step 2 requested PHX, and steps 16-17 show the update was executed with HAT035 DTW to PHX. This violates the policy requirement that non-basic-economy flight modifications must not change the destination.
